notes.author: ted
notes.text: Hal is on the monthly communion visit list. Two volunteers bring communion on the first Saturday of the month. He likes to have coffee ready, so call ahead.
notes.testPurpose: A pinned note that stays at the top of Hal's notes.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Hal is homebound. Call his home phone before any visit and let it ring a while.
notes.testPurpose: A Personal Note alert on an adult.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Stopped by to see Hal. He is in good spirits and still mails his check every month, even though I told him we would gladly pick it up. He asked about the old Book of John group, one person at a time.
notes.testPurpose: A note from the last seven days.
